competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times to decrease Defense for 2 turns with a 35% chance each.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times to deal damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken. Recovers your HP by 50% of the damage dealt.

effets.description: The target's HP will be recovered by 15% on each turn.

competences.description: When you receive HP recovery, increases your Attack Bar in proportion to the recovered HP instead and increases the damage dealt to the enemy, up to 200%, on the next turn. In addition, recovers your HP to the MAX when you defeat an enemy. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
